index.population: non-directory entries under root: regular files, file symlinks, directory symlinks, other non-dirs. Directories themselves are counted but not indexed.
index.sort: relative path encoded UTF-8 surrogateescape, bytewise ascending
index.secret_rule: path component case-insensitive match of *.env|.env|.env.*|.envrc|*credential*|*secret*|id_*|*.pem (tools/souji-verify.sh is_secret_shaped). Matching paths are not opened.
index.classification: Header magic wins over extension. Reads are <=200 bytes. Secret-shaped paths are never opened. PACK->git-pack; DIRC->git-index; zlib 78 01/5e/9c/da under .git/objects/ (not pack/) -> git-loose-object even if the first 200 bytes contain no NUL; %PDF -> pdf or pdf-supplement; JPEG/PNG/GIF -> image; gzip/zip -> archive; pyc magic -> python-bytecode; UTF-16 BOM -> utf16-text; .pdf that is HTML -> html-named-pdf; .pdf that is JSON -> json-named-pdf; .jpg that is text -> text-named-image; .torrent that is HTML -> html-named-torrent.

hygiene.reason: kotodama-shokunin/.scratch is gitignored (check-ignore: .gitignore:6:.scratch/) and untracked (ls-files count 0). Owning lane is ahead of origin/main with a dirty worktree. Province forbids removal while the owning lane has dirty or unpushed work. Counts moved during this seat (47 unpushed/31 dirty at 15:59, 49 unpushed/28 dirty at the spot-check, see observed_commands for the embedded snapshot).

handoff.scope: S69 classified only the 0-based i%16==4 slice of non-directory entries under kotodama-shokunin/.scratch. Residues other than 4 are not this seat. Full K1 coverage needs residues 0-15 against a population_path_sha256 match; this tree is live, so independent walks will not partition one snapshot.
handoff.drift: Recon walks before the index saw 527777 find-files, then 535606/535614 filenames, then this index 578529 entries and 20516969010 apparent bytes. Do not reconcile seats by count alone.

handoff.mass: Shard bytes are led by pdf-supplement (true %PDF). Population mass is repeated clone/run trees plus duplicated supplement PDFs. large_duplicate_extra_bytes is basename+size, not a content hash. unique_inode_bytes is only ~937MB under apparent bytes, so most same-name copies are separate files, not hardlinks.
handoff.mislabel: Header pass found HTML saved as .pdf/.torrent/.txt, an error string saved as .jpg, JSON saved as .pdf, and one UTF-16 BOM file named .json. Those are split out of the magic classes.
handoff.secrets: 5 shard paths named outside-secret.txt match *secret* and were not opened. Population secret-shaped count at index time was 62, all that filename. stat on one shard path: size 8, regular file.
handoff.du_note: du -sh prints a rounded human label. The classified measurement is the snapshot st_size sum 20516969010, not the later du label. The tree was still growing (recon du 18G; embed du 28G).

reclass.reason: First pass trusted .pdf/.jpg/.torrent extensions and folded all /.git/ paths into git-metadata. Second pass classifies by header magic first (still <=200 bytes, secrets not opened) and only then by extension.

pass3.reason: zlib loose objects with no NUL in the first 200 bytes had been labeled git-text. UTF-16 BOM labeled binary. JSON bodies with a .pdf name labeled text-named-pdf.

pass4.reason: The 12 git-object-text rows are .git/objects/info/packs and info/alternates, which are text metadata, not loose objects. Folded into git-text.
